# D'nest — Homemade Artisan Chocolates

> D'nest is an Indian direct-to-consumer (D2C) confectionery brand crafting handcrafted homemade chocolates in small batches using 100% vegetarian ingredients and zero artificial preservatives.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: D'nest
- **Category**: Confectionery, Artisan Chocolate, Gourmet Food, Gifting
- **Country of Origin**: India
- **Ordering Channel**: Direct WhatsApp Catalog (+91 95291 76512)
- **WhatsApp Catalog URL**: https://wa.me/c/919529176512
- **Website**: https://dnest.co.in

## Products & Pricing
Each chocolate variant is packaged in a premium 200g jar.
All flavours are priced at **₹270 INR** (MRP ₹300, 10% discount).

1. **D'nest Peanut Chocolate Jar**
   - Description: Crunchy roasted peanuts blended into velvety homemade chocolate.
   - Net Weight: 200g Jar
   - Price: ₹270 INR (MRP ₹300)
   - Highlights: Roasted Peanuts, Pure Cocoa, 100% Vegetarian

2. **D'nest Gulkand Chocolate**
   - Description: Royal Shahi gulkand (sweet rose-petal preserve) harmoniously infused into rich homemade chocolate.
   - Net Weight: 200g Jar
   - Price: ₹270 INR (MRP ₹300)
   - Highlights: Authentic Rose Petal Gulkand, Rich Cocoa, 100% Vegetarian

3. **D'nest Mix Fruit Chocolate**
   - Description: Handpicked dried fruits and berries enveloped in homemade chocolate.
   - Net Weight: 200g Jar
   - Price: ₹270 INR (MRP ₹300)
   - Highlights: Real Dried Fruit Bits, Premium Cocoa, 100% Vegetarian

## Key USPs (Unique Selling Propositions)
- 100% Vegetarian (Green Dot certified)
- Zero Preservatives & Zero Artificial Shortcuts
- Handcrafted in fresh, small batches
- Frictionless WhatsApp ordering without requiring account creation or app installation
- Custom hampers available for weddings, corporate gifting, and festivals

## How Customers Order
1. Open WhatsApp catalog: https://wa.me/c/919529176512
2. Add flavours and quantities to cart
3. Send order via WhatsApp chat; confirmed directly with UPI/bank payment details and fast delivery dispatch.
